name: Activate Micromamba Environment
description: Activates the isolated Python 3.11 compbio environment containing all computational biology tools.

name: Install Conda-Forge Package
description: Installs a pre-compiled binary package from the conda-forge repository into the active environment.

name: Fetch PDB Structure File
description: Downloads 3D Cartesian coordinate PDB file directly from the RCSB Protein Data Bank.

name: Launch PyMOL with Structure
description: Launches the PyMOL 3D viewport and automatically loads the target PDB structure file.

name: PyMOL: Select Specific Residues
description: Creates a named selection set containing specific residue numbers in the protein chain.

name: PyMOL: Measure Inter-Atomic Distance
description: Calculates and draws a distance line in Angstroms (Å) between two atoms or residue selections.
example: distance hbond1, resi 120 and name NH1, resi 600 and name O1

name: PyMOL: Render Molecular Surface
description: Displays the 3D solvent-excluded molecular surface of the protein or active site.

name: PyMOL: Surface Vacuum Electrostatics
command: action -> generate -> vacuum electrostatics -> protein contact potential
description: Colors the protein surface by positive (blue) and negative (red) electrostatic charge distribution.
example: run via PyMOL GUI Action Menu or plugin APBS

name: Launch ChimeraX with Structure
description: Launches UCSF ChimeraX and loads the specified molecular structure in 3D mode.

name: ChimeraX: Fetch Direct from PDB
description: Fetches and opens a structure directly from RCSB inside ChimeraX command line.

name: ChimeraX: Color Specific Chain or Residues
description: Applies targeted color to specific residues or chains in the viewport.

name: OpenMM: Test CUDA Installation
description: Verifies that OpenMM detects your RTX 5070 GPU CUDA and OpenCL execution platforms.

name: PyTorch: Check CUDA GPU Availability
description: Verifies PyTorch is compiled with CUDA support and correctly identifies the RTX 5070.

name: ESMFold: Predict Structure from FASTA
description: Executes single-sequence ESMFold transformer model on GPU to predict 3D PDB structure.

name: ColabFold: Run Local Prediction
description: Executes MMseqs2 alignment + AlphaFold prediction locally with GPU acceleration.

name: GROMACS: Check Version & CUDA Support
description: Displays GROMACS build metadata, GPU acceleration status, and SIMD instruction sets.

name: GROMACS: Generate Topology from PDB
description: Converts PDB file into GROMACS coordinate structure (.gro) and molecular topology (.top).
example: gmx pdb2gmx -f 1cx2.pdb -o protein.gro -p topol.top -ff amber99sb-ildn -water tip3p

name: GROMACS: Solvate Protein Box
description: Fills periodic simulation box with explicit water molecules (TIP3P/SPC).
example: gmx solvate -cp box.gro -cs spc216.gro -o solvated.gro -p topol.top
